title: PMSM Field-Weakening Controller
text: 永磁同步电机弱磁控制器，输入 3 路、输出 1 路；{Modulation index threshold} 指定调制指数阈值、{Field-weakening controller integral gain} 指定积分增益、{Integral anti-windup gain} 指定抗积分饱和增益、{Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定模块采样时间，按实例取值。

params.name: Modulation index threshold
params.values: 调制指数阈值 1 (default) | positive number

params.name: Integral anti-windup gain
params.values: 抗积分饱和增益 10 (default) | positive number

params.name: Sample time (-1 for inherited)
params.values: 模块采样时间 -1 (default) | -1 or positive number
